status.en: 93 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 18% more than the week before, most of them in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib.
status.nb: 93 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 18 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Sana'a, Mokha og Marib.

summary.en: Houthi forces have stepped up missile strikes on Saudi targets, hitting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait and Dammam airport where a missile killed two people and injured eight, while Saudi Aramco ordered staff evacuation in Dhahran as clashes persist. Saudi-led coalition defenses continue to intercept missiles over Saudi territory and repel overnight attack waves. Yemeni forces reported more than a thousand strikes on Houthi positions in a single day, indicating intensified counter-offensive activity. NDTV notes the Houthis are employing a new weapon that is not a drone or missile. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
background.extractNb: Borgerkrigen i Jemen er en pågående konflikt i Jemen mellom Jemens internasjonalt tidligere anerkjente regjering, ledet av Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi, og Houthi-bevegelsen. Begge sider har allierte, i form av styrker, våpenstøtte og informasjon, og krigen anses å være en del av den pågående konflikten mellom Saudi-Arabia og Iran.
